explanation: scripts/fetch_data.mts can now restore the pinned data release while hypoexplorer-data is private: with GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN or a gh auth login session it resolves each pinned github.com release-asset URL through the releases API and downloads the asset by its API URL; without a token it fetches the pinned URLs as before and explains a 404. SHA-256 pins, retries and the files written are unchanged. README.md and DEVELOPMENT.md say the restore needs a GitHub account with access until publication.
